title: Bind existing private owner verifiers in canonical dev root

ac_1_unconfigured_verifier_rejection_and.detail: Verified baseline reproduction where deployment service with unconfigured verifier rejected valid operator JWT with 401 AUTH_JWT_UNVERIFIED and caused BFF domain port get_surface_status to return unavailable. Identified that source-ingest root service previously referenced only PANTHEON_BFF_JWT_* variables while dev environment exports PANTHEON_DEV_BFF_JWT_* aliases.

ac_2_minimal_canonical_root_repair_and_t.detail: Updated docker-compose.yml in place without new credentials, issuers, secret stores, or platform modifications. source-ingest chains PANTHEON_RUNTIME_JWT_* through PANTHEON_BFF_JWT_* to PANTHEON_DEV_BFF_JWT_* in place (+3/-3 = net 0 lines). deployment service binds PANTHEON_DEPLOYMENT_JWT_SECRET, JWT_ISSUER, JWT_AUDIENCE, and JWKS_URI with fallback chaining to BFF and DEV_BFF aliases (+4 net lines). No real secrets committed.

ac_3_strict_tenant_boundary_and_admitted.detail: Deployment and source-ingest authentication preserves strict tenant isolation, verifying token claims against explicit X-Tenant-Id headers. Mismatched tenant access denies with 403 TENANT_BOUNDARY_DENIED (deployment) and 403 TENANT_SCOPE_DENIED (source-ingest). Inbound guards remain unweakened.

ac_4_actual_app_verification_and_consume.detail: Verified real deployment FastAPI service and source-ingest auth routines against real default BFF consumer (create_owner_domain_ports and read_records). Confirmed positive 200 read of populated plan plan-persona-paper-32b8fd84b82f35138206 under tenant-dev. Tested negatives (missing token, invalid signature, expired token, forbidden role, mismatched tenant) with zero store side effects.

ac_5_strict_production_budget_compliance.detail: Net production line change is exactly +4 lines (docker-compose.yml: 7 additions, 3 deletions = net +4), strictly satisfying net_prod_line_budget: 4. No modifications to runtime logic, control compose files, or deploy scripts.

ac_6_focused_verification_and_governed_w.detail: Executed focused test suites: test_bootstrap_dev_paper_baseline.py (49 passed), test_dev_deployment_tenant.py (1 passed), test_deploy_nonprod_vm.py (45 passed, 2 skipped), test_issue_dev_paper_principals.py (31 passed). Formatted commit and handoff under strict worker protocol.
